extracted.intended_audience: Researchers, attorneys, state agencies, publishers, and members of the public who use or cite the Pennsylvania Code & Pennsylvania Bulletin
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural rules for accessing, citing, and using material from the Pennsylvania Code and Pennsylvania Bulletin, and for locating publication schedules and style guidance. Targeted at users who need to reference or query Pennsylvania rules, notices, and official publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pennsylvania Code citation format
rubrics_metrics.description: Cite all material in the Pennsylvania Code by title number and section number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example provided on page: 1 Pa. Code § 17.51.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pennsylvania Bulletin citation format
rubrics_metrics.description: Cite all material in the Pennsylvania Bulletin by volume and page number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bulletin update / access schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: The latest published information may be accessed every Friday at 9 a.m. EDT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should check at that time for the most recent Bulletin content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source provenance / official derivation
rubrics_metrics.description: The information for the Pennsylvania Code and Pennsylvania Bulletin included at this website has been derived directly from the Pennsylvania Code and the Pennsylvania Bulletin, the Commonwealth's official publication of rules and regulations and the Commonwealth’s official gazette for information and rulemaking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This indicates the site content is taken from the official Commonwealth publications; cite accordingly (see citation rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Restriction on reproduction for profit
rubrics_metrics.description: No part of the information on this website may be reproduced for profit or sold for profit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users must not reproduce or commercially sell site material; for suggestions or comments contact webmaster@PaBulletin.com.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulation / notice inquiry routing
rubrics_metrics.description: Questions regarding a regulation or notice should be directed to the promulgating agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The website does not handle substantive regulatory questions; contact the agency that issued the regulation/notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication authority and distribution statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Published and distributed by Fry Communications, Inc. in cooperation with the Legislative Reference Bureau under the policy, supervision and direction of the Joint Committee on Documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This identifies the organizations responsible for producing/distributing the online Pennsylvania Code & Bulletin content and indicates the official stewardship/oversight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference to Style Manual
rubrics_metrics.description: A Style Manual is linked from the site (Style Manual).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users formatting or preparing materials for publication or citation should consult the linked Style Manual for specific formatting and style conventions (link provided in footer).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference to Code and Bulletin publication schedules
rubrics_metrics.description: Links to 'Code Publication Schedule' and 'Bulletin Publication Schedule' are provided on the site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult those schedules (via the provided links) for timing and frequency of Code and Bulletin publications and any timing-sensitive procedural requirements.
